### gemini-code-assist[bot] · 2026-09-24 · COMMENTED

## Code Review

This pull request introduces sequential module prefetching and weight staging in pinned memory to the sequential pipeline, alongside renaming `sequential_prefetch` to `sequential_activation_prefetch`. The review feedback highlights that renaming `sequential_prefetch` is a breaking change for both configuration arguments and the `oneshot` entrypoint, suggesting keeping it as a deprecated parameter for backward compatibility. Additionally, the feedback recommends adding `from __future__ import annotations` to prevent runtime type errors on Python versions older than 3.10, and using `stack.enter_context` for a more idiomatic cleanup of the background thread pool executor.
